description: This file defines the MedicalRecordService class, which provides methods to interact with the 'medical_records' table in a database via Supabase. It includes methods for listing, retrieving, creating, and deleting medical records associated with patients.

classes.name: MedicalRecordService
classes.description: A service class providing methods to manage medical records in the database.

methods.name: listForPatient
methods.description: Retrieves a list of medical records for a specific patient, ordered by creation date descending.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a single medical record by its unique identifier.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new medical record in the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a medical record by its ID.
